pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Chinese word means "daughter"? (1 mark)
   A. 有 yǒu
   B. 是 shì
   C. 哥哥 gēge
   D. 女儿 nǚ'ér

2. What is special about Mandarin words for brothers and sisters? (1 mark)
   A. They are only used by adults
   B. They have no tones
   C. There are different words for older and younger ones
   D. They are all the same word

3. In the Chinese week, which day is 星期一? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Saturday
   C. Sunday
   D. Monday

4. Fill the blank: 今天是星期____。 (Today is Wednesday.) (1 mark)
   A. 三
   B. 五
   C. 二
   D. 四

5. Which verb goes with 米饭? (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 看
   C. 来
   D. 喝

6. What does 早饭 (zǎofàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To drink
   B. Breakfast
   C. Spinach
   D. Apple

7. Which food group does 菠菜 belong to? (1 mark)
   A. Fruits
   B. Meat
   C. Vegetables
   D. Drinks

8. What does 风很大 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is small
   B. The rain is heavy
   C. The wind is very strong
   D. The cloud is light

9. Which word means "very" in 雨很大? (1 mark)
   A. 雨
   B. 大
   C. 很
   D. 的

10. What does 再见 (zàijiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good morning
   B. Hello
   C. Goodbye
   D. Classmates

11. What does 是 (shì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older sister
   B. Love
   C. Daughter
   D. Is, am, are

12. What does 东西 (dōngxi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Door
   B. Things
   C. Sofa
   D. Toilet

13. Which word is pronounced chànggē? (1 mark)
   A. 祝
   B. 快乐
   C. 唱歌
   D. 号

14. How can you stay safe with a digital reading journal? (1 mark)
   A. Use it without asking
   B. Share it with strangers
   C. Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   D. Post your address online

15. Which Chinese word means "to play"? (1 mark)
   A. 他们 tāmen
   B. 蛋糕 dàngāo
   C. 切 qiē
   D. 玩 wán

16. What does 不 bù mean in 我不喜欢咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. Also
   B. Not
   C. And
   D. Very

17. What does 喜欢 (xǐhuan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Apple
   B. Dinner
   C. To like
   D. Meat

18. Why does repetition help your reading? (1 mark)
   A. It builds smooth, fluent reading
   B. It erases the words
   C. It makes the text shorter
   D. It removes tones

19. What does 太阳 (tàiyáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Drought
   C. Sun
   D. Weather

20. Which tone mark is written in bàba? (1 mark)
   A. One mark, on the first a
   B. Two marks
   C. No marks
   D. A mark on the last a

21. What does 电视 (diànshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To put
   B. Table
   C. Television
   D. Kitchen

22. What does 星期一 (xīngqīyī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Monday
   C. Today
   D. Five

23. Which sentence means "On Wednesday I go to school."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期三去学校。
   B. 星期五,去清真寺。
   C. 明天是星期四。
   D. 星期天,去教堂。

24. What does 星期四 (xīngqīsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To go
   B. Three
   C. Thursday
   D. Seven

25. What does 零食 (língshí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To like
   B. Vegetables
   C. Snacks
   D. Breakfast

26. How many strokes does 手 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 3

27. What does 洗手 xǐshǒu mean? (1 mark)
   A. Brush teeth
   B. Eat
   C. Wash hands
   D. Clap hands

28. Fill the blank: 今天有____。 (Today there is sun.) (1 mark)
   A. 雨
   B. 雪
   C. 太阳
   D. 云

29. What does 没有 (méiyǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. It rains
   B. There is not
   C. Snow
   D. Sun

30. How many strokes do 左 and 右 each have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Friday, go to the mosque." (3 marks)

32. Write a dialogue of five lines in Chinese with pinyin between two learners about a food picture: ask what it is, answer, ask if they like it, and reply. (5 marks)

33. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We sing." (2 marks)

34. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào. (2 marks)

35. Why is a healthy plate made from several food groups? Give an example of a food from two groups. (3 marks)

36. Write two sentences about your family with 这是, and give pinyin. (3 marks)

37. Decide whether each statement is 对 or 错 and explain. Text: 今天有太阳,没有雨。 Statement: 今天有雨。 (3 marks)

38. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng. (2 marks)

39. Give the Mandarin words for older brother, younger brother and younger sister, with pinyin. (3 marks)

40. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the sofa?" (2 marks)

41. Read jiào, nǐ and hǎo and write each with its Chinese character and meaning. (3 marks)

42. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. (2 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 七 and 云. (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 放 and 蜡烛. (2 marks)

46. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛肉 and 女儿. (2 marks)

47. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today there are clouds." (2 marks)

48. Write the question for "Who is this?" and answer it with "This is my father", with pinyin. (2 marks)

49. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期天 and 早上好. (2 marks)

50. Name two fruits, one vegetable and one drink in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 女儿 nǚ'ér
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

2. C — There are different words for older and younger ones
   Mandarin has gēge and dìdi, jiějie and mèimei.

3. D — Monday
   Chinese counts the days from Monday.

4. A — 三
   三 is three, so Wednesday.

5. A — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

6. B — Breakfast
   早饭 (zǎofàn) means breakfast.

7. C — Vegetables
   菠菜 is spinach.

8. C — The wind is very strong
   风 is wind and 很大 is very big or strong.

9. C — 很
   很 hěn means very.

10. C — Goodbye
   再见 (zàijiàn) means goodbye.

11. D — Is, am, are
   是 (shì) means is, am, are.

12. B — Things
   东西 (dōngxi) means things.

13. C — 唱歌
   唱歌 is pronounced chànggē and means to sing.

14. C — Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   Keep personal information private.

15. D — 玩 wán
   玩 (wán) means to play.

16. B — Not
   不 is not.

17. C — To like
   喜欢 (xǐhuan) means to like.

18. A — It builds smooth, fluent reading
   Repeated reading builds fluency.

19. C — Sun
   太阳 (tàiyáng) means sun.

20. A — One mark, on the first a
   The second syllable is light, so it has no mark.

21. C — Television
   电视 (diànshì) means television.

22. B — Monday
   星期一 (xīngqīyī) means Monday.

23. A — 我星期三去学校。
   我星期三去学校。 (wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.) means "On Wednesday I go to school.".

24. C — Thursday
   星期四 (xīngqīsì) means Thursday.

25. C — Snacks
   零食 (língshí) means snacks.

26. C — 4
   撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.

27. C — Wash hands
   洗 is wash and 手 is hand.

28. C — 太阳
   太阳 is the sun.

29. B — There is not
   没有 (méiyǒu) means there is not.

30. C — 5
   Both have five strokes.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五,去清真寺。 xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? B: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo. A: 你喜欢吃香蕉吗? nǐ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo ma? B: 我喜欢。 wǒ xǐhuan. A: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line with pinyin.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们唱歌。 wǒmen chànggē.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Wednesday I go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Each group helps the body in a different way. For example rice gives energy and spinach gives vitamins.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 2 marks for examples.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba. 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: 错. The text says there is no rain (没有雨).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 错, 1 mark for finding 没有, 1 mark for the explanation.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: 哥哥 gēge, 弟弟 dìdi, 妹妹 mèimei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with pinyin.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在哪儿? shāfā zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 叫 jiào (to be called), 你 nǐ (you), 好 hǎo (good).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is above the sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 七: qī, seven. 云: yún, cloud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 放: fàng, to put. 蜡烛: làzhú, candle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 牛肉: niúròu, beef. 女儿: nǚ'ér, daughter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天有云。 jīntiān yǒu yún.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi? 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期天: xīngqītiān, Sunday. 早上好: zǎoshang hǎo, good morning.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 菠菜 bōcài, 茶 chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruits, 1 mark for vegetable, 1 mark for drink.
